metadata.description: Claude Code plugins: a themeable statusline (oh-my-status), a knowledge-base plugin (oh-my-knowledge) and a team of role agents (oh-my-teams)

plugins.name: oh-my-status
plugins.description: Themeable statusline for Claude Code. 9 color themes and 6 layouts.

plugins.name: oh-my-knowledge
plugins.description: A local, git-versioned knowledge base for Claude Code: look up, distill, lint and hand off durable knowledge.

plugins.name: oh-my-teams
plugins.description: Role agents (spec, implementer, reviewer, QA) and a lead skill: run a feature with a chosen review level, a converging review loop and a knowledge lookup per role.
